rules_based.name: Rules-Based Baseline
rules_based.strengths: Fast, fully explainable, transparent heuristic rules.
rules_based.weaknesses: Lacks nuance for zero-day phishing phrasing, lower recall.

logistic_regression.name: Logistic Regression + TF-IDF
logistic_regression.strengths: High precision and balanced F1-score, well-calibrated probabilities for uncertainty estimation.
logistic_regression.weaknesses: Requires feature extraction pipeline; linear decision boundary.

naive_bayes.name: Multinomial Naive Bayes + TF-IDF
naive_bayes.weaknesses: Conditional independence assumption may underestimate combined term risks.
